extension_rule: e=a+b-c, a,b,c in the current exponent set including zero; e is new
assignment_rule: Each detector assigns its eight shared tests bijectively to the two quadratic slots of its four regular factors; assignments are independent between detectors.
remaining_terms: Separate linear nonunit test/output terms, with no cancellation of the displayed constant or full-square monomials.
allowed_changes: Integer diagonal Laurent coordinate scalings and monomial row division, followed by literal monomial rewriting through the six unit coordinates.
row_multipliers: Independent component multipliers may be allowed initially; every full square forces them to coincide in its field factor.
scope: Only this factor design and the explicitly enumerated sequential six-unit bases. No lower bound for arbitrary quartics or Diophantine definitions is asserted.
